As patient has repeated episodes of symptoms at the same time every year. rather then a complex diagnosis\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EQ 2) Share the link to your own case report of a patient that you connected with and engaged while capturing his her sequential life events before and after the illness and clinical and investigational images along with your discussion of that case.\u0026nbsp;\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttp:\/\/roopabudde.blogspot.com\/2021\/07\/hepatic-abscess.html\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Q3)Testing peer review competency of the examinees) :\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EPlease go through the cases in the links shared above and provide your critical appraisal of the captured data in terms of completeness, correctness and ability to provide useful leads to analyze the diagnostic and therapeutic uncertainties around the cases share\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EQ 4)Please analyze the above linked patient data by first preparing a problem list for each patient (based on the shared data) and then discuss the diagnostic and therapeutic uncertainty around solving those problems. Also include the review of literature around sensitivity and specificity of the diagnostic interventions mentioned and same around efficacy of the therapeutic interventions mentioned for each patient.\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMULTI SYSTEM\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/nikithaedam48.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/18-year-old-malefrom-miryalagudawho-is.html?m=1\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOverview:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E18 year old male came with the chief complaints of back pain since 1 week ,low backache 1 week ago,fever since 5 days ,yellowish discolouration of eyes since 3 days ,vomitings (2 episodes) and loose stools(3 episodes)and blood tinged urine yesterday morning\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppraisal:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EExamination was very well done\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETemperature charting with the complete information\u0026nbsp; was apprisiable\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENegative points:\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EDiagnosis was not clear\u0026nbsp; can be evaluated in a better way\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ETreatment was given as a trial form\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMy analysis:\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIn my analysis as the patient has got covid antibodies positive\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAs he has Diabetes ... Whole time it was seen as DKA and infection rather than MIS-C\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ECNS\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/pallavi191.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/gm-cases.html?m=1\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOverview\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EA 28 year old male came with history of TB 1 month back came with\u0026nbsp; chief complaints of sudden fall followed by weakness of both the lower limbs (paraplegia) and loss of hand grip 10 days back, associated with bowel and bladder incontinence.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAppraisal\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe approach to the cause of the paralysis through a detailed history of case was done well\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENegative points\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;Tuberculosis affecting the nerve root through a cold abscess can be clinically found by examination\u0026nbsp; so i found ct was unnecessary without a surgery plan\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EThe history was inadequate about the abscess\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EMy analysis\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;The\u0026nbsp; spine wis secondarily affected in the TB.\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EProper examination for the local deficits of the involved region ... Is need\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EIf it is just due to compression of cold abscess will the draining of abscess helps him to continue his normal life\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ERenal\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003Ehttps:\/\/61tejarshini.blogspot.com\/2021\/06\/general-medicine-case-discussion.html?m=1\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EOverview\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp; creatinine and halting the damage to kidney without going to irreversible failure was commendable\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAlso dialysis helped the patient's encephalopathy\u0026nbsp;\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003EAll the problems like infection, hypertension and chronic proteinuria causing kidney failure were addressed well and treated\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003ENegative points\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u003Cbr\u003E\u003C\/div\u003E\u003Cdiv\u003E\u0026nbsp;addiction history\u0026nbsp;
